newsitem.title: JAPAN: QGPC cuts June Qatar Land crude price-traders.
newsitem.headline: QGPC cuts June Qatar Land crude price-traders.

text.p: Qatar General Petroleum Corp (QGPC) has cut its price formula for June-lifting Qatar Land crude oil to its Asian clients by three cents per barrel and that of Qatar Marine by six cents per barrel, traders in Tokyo said on Thursday.

According to the QGPC formula, June Qatar Land was calculated at Oman plus 30 cents per barrel, which translated into $18.05 per barrel, and June Qatar Marine at Oman minus three cents per barrel, or $17.72 per barrel.
May Qatar Land was set at Oman plus 33 cents per barrel, or $19.58 per barrel, and May Qatar Marine at Oman plus three cents per barrel, or $19.28 per barrel.
Qatar's retroactive price formula is based on the official selling price of Oman crude issued monthly by Oman's Ministry of Petroleum and Minerals.
